absolute_error_conclusion: BIRDSAI TestReal forecast error is substantially above the measured post-correction geometric residual envelope.
ensemble_gain_conclusion: Primary ensemble gains versus mean individual-seed error are statistically supported but remain below F95; they are small-to-moderate relative to the empirical residual scale.
claim_guardrails: F50/F95 are empirical BIRDSAI TestReal post-correction geometric residual references.
Do not call them universal irreducible annotation-noise floors.
Do not subtract them from forecast errors as if additive error decomposition were established.
Do not transfer them directly to Fresh WildBox or BAMBI.
Describe ensemble gain over mean seed as statistically consistent but below the conservative F95 envelope.
